stem_book: State whether the following are true or false. (i) Equilibrium reactions can take place only in closed vessels. (ii) The equilibrium state can be attained from both sides of the chemical reaction. (iii) A reaction continues even after the attainment of equilibrium. (iv) The concentrations of reactants and products become equal when equilibrium is attained. (v) The properties of the system become constant at equilibrium and remain unchanged thereafter.
reason: Quick-recap true/false: five parts with separate answers. Manifest split it into 5 entries sharing one code.
work: At equilibrium concentrations are constant, not equal -> (iv) False; rest True.
